notes: Every request carries X-Runway-Version: 2024-11-06. Text-to-video and image-to-video create tasks; GET /v1/tasks/{id} reports PENDING, THROTTLED, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED with output URLs that expire within days, FAILED or CANCELLED; DELETE cancels or removes a task with 204. GET /v1/organization proves a key without cost. OLP lists jobs from its own records.
